entries.notes: Selected the TAS-20K(2003) three-factor confirmatory factor analysis for the single participant sample. The paper also reports TAS-20K(1996) and S-TAS loadings on the same sample; these were treated as alternative scale-version solutions and not merged. TAS-20K(2003) was selected because it is the author-recommended Korean TAS-20 retaining the original 20 items, structure, and scoring. F1=Difficulty identifying feelings, F2=Difficulty describing feelings, F3=Externally oriented thinking. Blank/nonprinted CFA loading cells were coded null rather than zero. Estimation method was not explicitly reported. Age was computed as a weighted mean from male and female subgroup means and ns: (272*23.4 + 136*23.0)/408 = 23.3.
